title: The Neighbour — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 100bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal life philosophy Spanish French language learning Perth suburb
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The neighbour relationship has a specific protocol
You wave across the fence and that's sufficient for the haul
Of any given morning — you don't need the full biography
You need the acknowledging wave and that's the geography

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
La relación con el vecino tiene un protocolo específico
[The neighbour relationship has a specific protocol]
Saludas por encima de la cerca y eso es lo que significa
[You wave across the fence and that's what it means]
No necesitas toda la biografía para cada mañana
[You don't need the whole biography for every morning]
El saludo de reconocimiento es toda la campaña
[The acknowledging wave is the whole campaign]

[Chorus — English]
The neighbour knows something I don't know
He knows exactly when I leave for work and which way I go
The neighbour knows the pattern of my bin night without a word
And I know his — and this knowledge is the most that's been transferred
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
La relation avec le voisin a un protocole spécifique
[The neighbour relationship has a specific protocol]
Tu salues par-dessus la clôture — c'est la technique
[You wave across the fence — that's the technique]
Tu n'as pas besoin de la biographie complète chaque matin
[You don't need the full biography every morning]
Le signe de la main dit tout ce qu'il faut — c'est le destin
[The wave says everything needed — that's the destiny]

[Outro — All three languages]
The neighbour knows… El vecino sabe… Le voisin sait
The wave contains everything — El saludo lo contiene todo — Le signe contient tout
That's my boy
